verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships an official CLI, abctl, for running/deploying Airbyte via Docker, and PyAirbyte is explicitly positioned for 'every Python and AI developer,' but neither is documented as a CLI purpose-built for AI-native/agentic workflows — abctl is deployment-focused and PyAirbyte is a Python library, not a CLI. missing for 10: no evidence of a CLI marketed/designed specifically for AI-native or agentic use cases, no independent/hands-on confirmation of abctl usage in AI workflows.
